catalysts.headline: Q1 FY2027 results: total revenue $478.1M (+15% YoY), non-GAAP EPS $0.70 (beat $0.58 consensus by $0.12); operating cash flow $132M, adjusted free cash flow $143M. Raised FY2027 non-GAAP EPS guidance to $3.29-$3.37 (full-year revenue guidance $1.998B-$2.010B). Set Q2 FY2027 guidance: revenue $486M-$487M (~+15% YoY), non-GAAP EPS $0.80-$0.82.
catalysts.note: Sources disagree on what the prior EPS guidance range was before this raise -- one cites a prior range of $3.21-$3.29, implying a genuine raise, while another says revenue guidance was merely maintained rather than raised from $1.99B-$2.00B; see conflicts. This is consistent with the 2026-08-27 guidance raise already on file.
